description_en: Calls DeleteVersionWhiteDevices to delete the device whitelist of a system version or application version
description_zh: 调用DeleteVersionWhiteDevices删除系统版本或应用版本的设备白名单
kebab_example: aliyun iovcc delete-version-white-devices --device-ids 11,22,33 --project-id P0VFCREU --version-type FOTA --version-id 12345 --device-id-type hardware_id --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteVersionWhiteDevices

parameters.description_en: The list of device IDs, separated by commas (,).
